tools.name: orochi_mutate_prompt
tools.description:
Generate mutated prompt variants from a base system prompt.

Orochi self-modification primitive: produces n candidate prompt rewrites
using perturbation strategies (emphasize_ethics, deepen_reasoning,
tighten_format, add_council_focus, reorder_clauses, strengthen_truth,
add_velocity_note, soften_tone).

tools.name: orochi_evolve_weights
tools.description:
Generate EGGROLL low-rank weight-delta proposals.

Instead of mutating full weight matrices (dangerous, OOM-prone), Orochi
proposes low-rank deltas ΔW = U @ V^T where U,V are rank-`rank` matrices.
Each proposal is stored as a staged weight snapshot, ready for the
orchestrator to apply after Nemesis-Alpha evaluation passes.

tools.name: orochi_evaluate
tools.description:
Nemesis-Alpha adversarial evaluation.

The challenger (default C34-PREDATOR) attacks the weakest assumption in the
candidate prompt/weight config and returns a verdict:
PASS / CHALLENGED / FAIL. If CHALLENGED, the candidate needs hardening
before deployment.

tools.name: orochi_auto_improve
tools.description:
Full Orochi auto-improvement loop: Evaluate -> Mutate -> Select -> Deploy.

Each cycle:
  1. Evaluate current best prompt via Nemesis-Alpha
  2. Mutate to produce variants
  3. Evaluate each variant
  4. Select the highest-integrity variant that passes
  5. If integrity >= min_integrity and verdict PASS -> deploy (save as active)

Returns the full cycle history and the deployed prompt.

tools.description: Save an Orochi state snapshot (prompt + weight proposals + metadata).

tools.name: orochi_rollback
tools.description: Roll back Orochi state to a previous snapshot by ID.

tools.name: orochi_full_pipeline
tools.description:
Chain: mutate -> evaluate -> auto-improve -> snapshot.

The canonical Orochi self-evolution entry point. Returns the deployed
prompt and a snapshot id for rollback.

Fail at waves or gates loops back to council (recirculation), matching your drawn back-edge.
Args:
    query: Task or question.
    depth: fast, deep, mastery.

tools.name: reason_with_mode
tools.description:
Run one explicit reasoning mode with its native protocol + council + confidence rule.
Modes: deductive, inductive, abductive, probabilistic, causal, analogical, moral, critical, auto.
Auto picks via skill_route top hit.
Args:
    query: Problem or claim.
    mode: Reasoning mode.
    depth: fast, deep, mastery.

tools.name: critical_think
tools.description:
Run the 7-phase critical-thinking protocol (restate/decompose/hypotheses/adversarial/evidence/edge_sweep/synthesis).
Args:
    problem: Problem to dissect.
    phases: all or comma list subset; quick=restate,hypotheses,synthesis; standard=restate,decompose,adversarial,synthesis.

tools.name: fallacy_scan
tools.description:
Scan an argument for classic deductive/inductive/abductive fallacies.
Args:
    argument: Claim + premises to check.

tools.name: reasoning_modes_list
tools.description: List all implemented reasoning modes + critical phases + fallacy coverage.

tools.name: thinking_trace
tools.description:
Produce a structured, consumable thinking trace for a query.

Returns ordered reasoning phases with prompts, so the model can reason
step-by-step using the Quillan thinking engine. Each phase is a thinking
step the model should fill in.

tools.name: thinking_trace_save
tools.description: Save a filled thinking trace (model's reasoning) for audit/replay.

tools.name: complexity_route
tools.description: Route a query through the v5.4.0-ONI Complexity Router (fast/balanced/deep).

tools.name: thermo_refine
tools.description: Apply v5.4.0-ONI Modality-Isolated Thermo Diffusion (Langevin refinement) to low-confidence text.

tools.name: formula_compute
tools.description: Compute a v5.4.0-ONI cognitive formula (aqcs, eemf, qhis, dqro, qcrdm, aqml, qcie, qics, qssr, jqld, dqso, qps).

tools.name: thinking_trace_list
tools.description: List persisted thinking traces.

tools.name: thinking_trace_replay
tools.description: Replay a persisted thinking trace by ID.
